reconstructions: All drawings are original SVG constructions; reference photographs are not embedded.
Black Rock is a static perspective playa scene with a 21.726144 km marked course; measured-mile gate placement and mountain shapes are reconstructed, not surveyed 1997 coordinates.
Jet thrust/drag curves, spool time constants, brake heat, failure thresholds and fuel flow are simulator estimates, not an exact validated aerodynamic or engine model.
Airspeed assumes still air; displayed Mach uses a 340.3 m/s reference. The two-way record is shown separately from a single simulated pass.
Sound is random-phase spectral resynthesis informed by the official Run 65 field recording; it is not a cockpit recording. See audio-profile.json for limitations.
Remaining shared circuits are optional sandbox routes; the car's rear steering geometry is retained.
